title: Apparent Consumption of Selected Foodstuffs, Australia
excerpt:
Provides experimental estimates of apparent consumption per capita of selected foods based on sales of products in Australia
Between 2023-24 and 2024-25, consumption of cereal-based products decreased by 0.6 grams (-1.0%) to 62.1 grams per capita per day. The decrease was spread across several product groups, including:
Sweet biscuits, down 0.3 grams (-2.2%) to 13.6 grams per capita per day
